newsitem.title: UK: Blacks Leisure firm on earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: Blacks Leisure firm on earnings hopes.

text.p: Shares in Blacks Leisure Plc were up 10p to 475 by 0820 GMT amid hopes that the sports equipment and fashion retailer will announce bumper profits next month, dealers and market makers said.
"Some people think the stock is cheap below 500p. The market is expecting some good figures next month," one market maker said.
The transformation of football shirts and trainers into hot fashion for teenagers has helped push Black's shares about 10 fold over the past 13 months.
Over the past six months alone, the stock has outperformed the FTSE All Share Index by about 46 percent, according to data from Reuters Securities 3000.
Analysts are predicting the company can make profits of more than nine million stg for the year to end February, compared with 2.1 million stg in the previous financial year.
Sales in the 44 weeks to January 4,1997 were up 22 percent on a like-for-like basis, and up 45 percent overall.
